mision.descripcion: Facilitate a solidarity-driven and efficient response to natural disasters, ensuring every donation and volunteer effort arrives safely, verified, and timely.
mision.conectarDescripcion: We unite donors, support centers, and volunteers to multiply the impact of every helping hand.
mision.verificarDescripcion: We validate centers and shelters through a rigorous process to ensure trust and transparency.
mision.responderDescripcion: We provide up-to-date information so help arrives quickly and where it is truly needed.

hero.descripcion: SOS.exe connects people, verified centers, and volunteers so help reaches those who need it most during natural disasters in Bolivia.

valores.informacionDescripcion: We keep priority needs, alerts, and ways to collaborate visible.
